authentication.description: Browsing the store is public with no auth. Purchases are one-time checkouts on the store page.

description: The J-Dawgs AI Tool Store is a web store of 411 AI tools built for AI agents and the people who run them, sold by J-Dawgs Industries for one-time prices - no subscriptions, no ads, and customer information is never sold. Every entry is verified working before it lists. The Unlimited Pass is $99.99 one-time and covers the store. This is a web store, not an API: browse and buy on the store page; the same catalog is readable by agents through the jdawgs-mcp MCP server (PyPI: jdawgs-mcp). No A2A JSON-RPC endpoint is offered. Operated by J-Dawgs Industries (JDawgindustries), Springfield, Missouri.
name: J-Dawgs AI Tool Store
